# Missing attachments

Every reference below names a file that is **not** in this vault. None may
render as a working link or as a broken-image icon; each must be marked missing.

- Image embed: ![[gone.png]]
- Image embed with a size: ![[gone.png|200]]
- Image embed with alt text: ![[gone.png|a lost diagram]]
- Markdown image: ![a lost chart](attachments/gone.png)
- Markdown image without alt text: ![](attachments/gone.png)
- File link: [[gone.pdf]]
- File link with label: [[gone.pdf|the lost report]]
- Markdown file link: [the lost report](attachments/gone.pdf)
- Note embed: ![[Gone Note]]
